audit.why: Talon's R is Shadow Assault. Rebuttal is 38s at rank 1 scaling to 26, Solar Snare 11s — those numbers are the trade windows. Mel is she/her per champ-gender.js.
audit.corrected: Name fixed, cooldowns given real numbers, pronouns corrected, chart layers aligned with rewritten whys.
